title: RPME tests the register with logical AND instead of the PME bit
description: A logical AND tests the register for nonzero instead of testing the PME bit. It is dormant at the inventoried DSDT/SSDT call sites.
not_established: No whole-ROM packaging or hardware effect is established.
remediation: Exact-method, length-preserving AML corrections and ACPICA replay. C1.
